sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze this graph. Preserve the prior instructions: ordinary crew members must not be forced into the polar-training relationships. The universal sh:minCount constraints for hasCrewTrainingRecord and hasPolarTrainingRecord on IMO102CrewMemberShape incorrectly require both relationships for every crewMember; scope those relationship requirements to members having a controlled master, chief-mate, or OICNW role, while retaining both relationships as separate required relationships for applicable members. Also repair the first matrix SPARQL constraint: its SELECT returns only records satisfying a valid matrix branch, so invalid applicability, requiredTrainingLevel, or STCW combinations are silently accepted. Make it select violations (for example, use the negation of the complete matrix condition) and retain all non-applicable and Basic/Advanced branches.
